summary: Iteration 21 - Company Logo upload feature validated end-to-end. Backend 10/10 pytest pass covering: valid PNG upload returning data URL, GET /api/companies exposes logo_data_url, rejection of invalid content-type (400), <100 byte file (400), 200 bytes of garbage claiming image/png caught by PIL verify (400), oversized JPEG > 2MB (400), collaborator role forbidden (403), DELETE unsets logo_* fields, PDFs (opening-minutes/closing-minutes/report) embed /XObject only when admin's active company 'default' has a logo (verified both positive and negative case). Frontend Playwright verified: create dialog shows 'Logo de la Empresa (opcional)' with logo-file-input, logo-choose-btn, logo-preview-img; selecting a valid PNG renders the preview; newly created company card shows the logo via company-logo-<id> img with a data:image base64 src; logo-update-<id> file input replaces the logo and the card refreshes. The logo-remove-<id> red X button triggers the backend DELETE correctly at API level (covered by pytest) but uses window.confirm() which Playwright does not auto-accept, so the UI removal could not be auto-verified in this run. Not an app bug.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py L3103-3134 upload_company_logo: solid validation (content-type allow-list + size min/max + PIL verify). Consider also rejecting oversized AFTER base64 encoding since the stored base64 string is ~33% larger than raw bytes; MongoDB document limit is 16MB so a 2MB raw logo -> ~2.7MB base64 is safe but worth a comment.

Companies.js L93-97 removeLogo uses window.confirm which blocks e2e automation. Minor testability concern - consider swapping to an AlertDialog (shadcn) with data-testid-ed confirm/cancel buttons for future Playwright coverage. Functional behavior is correct.
server.py _company_logo_flowable L1764-1780: correctly catches all exceptions and returns None, so PDF generation is never broken by a bad logo. Good defensive coding.

server.py POST /companies/{id}/logo uses require_role('admin','sgsst_manager') but GET /companies returns logo_data_url to any authenticated user - acceptable since logos are not sensitive, but worth confirming intent.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (create-with-logo + card display + update verified; remove verified via backend test, UI window.confirm not auto-acceptable)

seed_data_creation: Pytest fixture creates TEST_LogoCompany (cleaned up on teardown) and a TEST_Audit for logo PDF (cleaned up). Frontend Playwright run created one company 'TEST_UI_Logo_<ts>' left behind (not auto-deleted); admin can remove via UI if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Logo upload feature fully verified. If future test agents need auth with requests, use requests.Session() and POST /api/auth/login-email; the backend sets httpOnly session cookie (no token field in JSON body). All PDF endpoints correctly embed the logo only when the admin's active company ('default') has logo_data_url set. The three PDFs that embed logo: /api/audits/{id}/opening-minutes/pdf, /api/audits/{id}/closing-minutes/pdf, /api/audits/{id}/report/pdf.
rca_of_the_issue: Not applicable - feature addition verified without issues. Two initial test failures were due to wrong endpoint (/auth/email/login vs /auth/login-email) and response shape (cookie-based auth vs JSON token); fixed the test to use requests.Session with cookie auth.
